title: Let the Agent Cook: Building AI-Native Developer Workflows
description: In this hands-on workshop, explore how to build powerful developer workflows using [AGENTS.md](http://AGENTS.md), reusable skills, MCP servers, memory, and multi-agent systems. Through live demos, learn how to leverage these capabilities for open-source contributions and Web3 development, building workflows that are reusable, reliable, and safe.
